fields.topic: Joint strength, density, rotational stiffness and mass
fields.finding: Actual member-end axial force, bending and torsion are included in the annular-sleeve and ring-bond demand. The selected frame reaches 3.356559 kN m end bending and 1.118657 kN m torsion. Equal-stress resized joints attain the requested scalar target by construction, without surplus reserve. The 1550 kg/m3 composite density is assumed; Toray's laminate strength and Henkel's prepared-aluminum shear result do not establish the proposed SiC joint.
fields.needed: A joint architecture, laminate orientation/thickness, bondline and surface treatment, peel and transverse/torsional shear interaction, cyclic/environmental data, contact stress and measured rotational stiffness. Include all hardware mass.
fields.prohibited_inference: Scalar sleeve/bond sizing does not establish a rigid joint, full multiaxial strength or a manufactured joint mass.
